assessments.reasoning: Event 41b4103c7cdb438db2faf0f4faaa9804, digest-matched project LICENSE, condition 4 at [800,1832). The prohibition and all three alternatives occur in this passage.

challenge.method: Tested the threshold at 50 and 51 users, the counting period, and whether ordinary permission or any enterprise contract suffices.
challenge.results: The count exception includes 50 individual natural persons with direct application access within any rolling 30-day period. At 51 it is unavailable. The separate alternatives are specific prior written permission from the copyright holder or a duly executed enterprise license expressly permitting the modification.

limitations: The finding concerns the prohibition as written. Applying an exception requires facts about users or permission, and the notice preserves prior-license materials.
reasoning: Condition 4 expressly prohibits altering, removing, obscuring or replacing Open WebUI branding in any deployment or distribution. It includes the name, logo and other distinguishing visual, textual or symbolic identifiers.
